name: INVISIBLE DESIRE
source:
Ichimaru becomes a subject of the 12th Division experiment. He visits Hitsugaya room at night to test acquired abilities.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
市丸成為十二番隊實驗的對象。為了測試獲得的能力，他在夜裡來到日番谷的房間。
